name: Player
description: Audio and video keep playing as you go elsewhere in the app, in a mini player and on the lock screen, and pick up where you stopped on any device; with skips, speed, captions and picture in picture. A sound's own tab is a full player: cover, chapters (inside .m4b and .mp3 files), bookmarks, a sleep timer. Times in a note play from there, and the queue lists what the inbox holds to watch, listen to and read.

queue.description: what the inbox holds to watch, listen to and read, with how far you got

show.description: one shelf only, or all with a switch between them
